mono.subject: 24-newton
mono.title: 科学：牛顿与自然规律
mono.titleEnglish: Newton and the Laws of Nature

phrase.zh: 用同一条规律，连接苹果与月亮。
phrase.en: One law can connect an apple and the Moon.

visual.zh: 牛顿形象、仪器与轨迹将日常物体和天体运动放在一起。这里没有重现苹果落下的历史现场，线条是关于自然规律的象征。
visual.en: Newton, instruments and trajectories place everyday objects beside celestial motion. The scene does not reconstruct a historical falling apple; its lines symbolize natural laws.

background.zh: NASA 的引力教学资料以 1687 年的牛顿引力定律为重要起点：两物体间的引力与质量乘积成正比，与中心距离平方成反比。在许多日常与工程条件下，这一描述仍很有用；它不是相对论已经“作废”的旧知识。
background.en: NASA’s gravity guide highlights Newton’s 1687 law: gravitational force is proportional to the product of the masses and inversely proportional to the square of the distance between their centers. It remains a useful approximation in many everyday and engineering conditions, rather than knowledge simply discarded by relativity.
